cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import importlib.util, json
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
over = json.load(open('tests/over_cap.json'))
atoms = over['rules']
svcs = over['services']
# 1) drop-only rules with an over-cap product must still be E_COMPLEXITY
req = {'services': svcs, 'rules': [{'action': 'drop', 'when': a['when']} for a in atoms], 'queries': []}
print('drop only:', json.loads(m.process(json.dumps(req).encode())))
# 2) atoms only inside an unreachable boolean branch
unreach = {'op': 'and', 'args': [{'op': 'false'}] + [a['when'] for a in atoms]}
req2 = {'services': svcs, 'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': unreach}], 'queries': []}
print('unreachable branch:', json.loads(m.process(json.dumps(req2).encode())))
# 3) same atoms but only 8 -> under cap, works
req3 = {'services': svcs, 'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'or', 'args': [a['when'] for a in atoms[:8]]}}], 'queries': []}
out = json.loads(m.process(json.dumps(req3).encode()))
print('8 atoms ok:', out.get('ok'), 'states', len(out['dfa']['next']))
# 4) contradictory: allow the same atom that is dropped
req4 = {'services': svcs, 'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': a['when']} for a in atoms[:8]] +
        [{'action': 'drop', 'when': {'op': 'or', 'args': [a['when'] for a in atoms[:8]]}}], 'queries': []}
out4 = json.loads(m.process(json.dumps(req4).encode()))
print('contradictory under cap:', out4.get('ok'), out4.get('dfa', {}).get('accept'), out4.get('dfa', {}).get('next'))
EOF
